Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates subtle radiolucent streaks outlining the mediastinal structures, particularly along the left heart border and extending into the neck (continuous diaphragm sign), which is characteristic of spontaneous pneumomediastinum caused by alveolar rupture (Macklin effect) rather than esophageal or bronchial injury.
